About

mF-ONE is a tokenised investment strategy that provides indirect exposure to Fasanara Capital's diversified private credit and digital asset strategy. mF-ONE offers instant redemption capacity with a scheduled refill cycle, while remaining fully transferable to investors meeting eligibility requirements.

The strategy is managed and monitored by Fasanara, acting as the appointed strategy manager, with ongoing oversight of risk parameters and performance. DeFi integrations include protocols such as Morpho.
